scope_of_work.description: Proposed reconstruction and reinforcement of left wall (Exposure 2) as per plan.

scope_of_work.description: Construction fence will be installed if necessary.

scope_of_work.description: Minor details not usually shown or specified, but necessary for proper construction of any part of the work, shall be included as if they were indicated in the drawings.

scope_of_work.description: Masonry construction and materials shall conform to all requirements of ACI 530-92/ASCE 6-92.

scope_of_work.description: Match the existing size, color and texture of the installed brick with the new brick.

scope_of_work.description: DEP construction noise management: §24-220 noise mitigation plan.
